description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low bamboo rack contains evenly spaced upright slots for empty plates. Side: Slotted crossbars bridge two woven side cheek panels. Rear: The rear rail and raised feet leave an open drying gap underneath. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
